entry.title: New: Resolution 518 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE ACQUISITION OF PRIVATE PROPERTIES BY EMINENT DOMAIN, BEING PORTIONS OF TAX MAP KEYS: 1-4-001:002 AND 1-4-001:003, SITUATED AT KAPOHO, PUNA, COUNTY AND STATE OF HAWAIʻI, FOR THE RECONSTRUCTION OF LAVA INUNDATED ROADS, COUNTY JOB NUMBER E-4523, SPECIFICALLY POHOIKI ROAD

Authorizes the Corporation Counsel to initiate proceedings in eminent domain for the taking, acquisition, and condemnation of private property for the purpose of widening Pohoiki Road to comply with current roadway standards.
